units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:18">Targ. Job XXXI, 18</cite> (v. <cite ref="V00241"><he>תּוּנַחְתָּא</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Arakhin 17a:17">Arakh. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לעניין תוקפא וכ׳</he> as regards ruling with rigor or with leniency.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:4">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>דאתיא מיטרא בנ׳</he> when the rain comes down gently, opp. <he>בשפיכותא</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 34a:4">Sabb. 34ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>צריך למימרינהו בנ׳</he> he must say them in a gentle way; a. e.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 30b:21">Snh. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 32b:13">Pes. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי נ׳</he> why this ease of mind (why does he say, Let thy mind be set at rest as thou didst mine)?
